messages.subject: Plotting long arrays with plot()
parts:
When you call plot(stanfit), if you have long arrays of values (eg X[1,200]) the plot truncates the display of these.

Is there any way to show a simple summary like the default plot command, but which wraps the values rather than truncating them?

I am using STAN v2.7, R 3.1.2 and calling within RStudio 0.99.442

Thanks!
